tagline: 奥林巴斯便携相机，1991 年发布
description: 奥林巴斯于1991年推出的便携相机。配备35mm 1:3,5 ( 3 elements )。active infrared, focusing automatically from 0.35 m to infinity。

specs.对焦: active infrared, focusing automatically from 0.35 m to infinity
specs.曝光测光: automatically, shutter speeds between 1/15 and 1/500 sec., aperture between f3.5 and f16
specs.英文简介: The Écru is an all-automatic compact camera for 35mm film, made by Olympus.
